message: `name` is bound: each target writes the transition's class names when the component compiles, so it is a string literal.
help: Write the name as a string: `name="fade"`.

message: `name` is empty: it is the prefix of the transition's class names, one name with no whitespace.
help: Write the name as a string: `name="fade"`.

message: `appear` is bound: each target decides when the component compiles whether the first element enters, so it is the bare attribute, `{true}` or `{false}`.
help: Write `appear` alone, or leave it out.
